The token is bound only to the user ID, not to the address to which it was sent, and changing the address does not revoke outstanding tokens.  As a result, Pocket ID marks the newly supplied address as verified even though the user never proved control of it. Pocket ID subsequently returns that address with `email_verified: true` in OIDC claims.
